name: openbot
description: A local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates. Run Codex, Claude, and Grok with dedicated workspaces, task queues, file sharing, browser control, and agent-to-agent collaboration.

latest_release.name: OpenBot v0.70.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Restart a self-hosted server from the server menu by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8373
* Keep the saved OpenCode key away from the free models by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8374
* Add an app icon picker to the mobile app by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8376
* Add the shared test Google account to the development settings by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8378
* Show the cloud server plans in mobile Settings > Billing by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8382
* Open a new agent after you create it by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8384
* Keep a same-page sign-in after a secure password fill by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8383
* Let the user choose the agents of each Vault item by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8377
* Add two-step codes to Vault logins in the mobile app by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8379
* build(nix): install OpenBot 0.69.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8385
* Show a notice when a Codex model is at capacity by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8394
* Continue an agent turn that ends on a Portuguese or status next step by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8393
* Add Image and Video steps to workflows by @NorbertBodziony in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8389
* Play M4A, WAV and AAC attachments in the chat by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6831
* Ask before closing the window stops working agents on Windows and Linux by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6841
* Show the agent's text above a waiting question in the mobile app by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8405
* Offer the Android app as an APK on openbot.run by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8404
* Let users copy the cause behind the general agent error by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6842
* Add the Agents page to mobile Settings and Server Settings by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8396
* End failed channel replies when their run completes by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8402
* Retry a flaky smoke item one time in smoke-and-ship by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8410
* Let admins edit a custom provider of a server in the mobile app by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8413
* Add Ultrafast and Claude fast mode to the mobile app by @nrb-dev in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8422
* Keep a host answering devices when one device's setup stops by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8423
* Report a shared database failure from list_tables, not an empty list by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/6685
* Explain a Hermes turn that fails with admitted_turn_failed by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8424
* Fill a password and its confirmation in one secure fill by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8426
* Send the skill card's yes to the chat where Save was clicked by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8433
* Replace an OpenCode session of another folder by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8432
* Let a channel task save a key that the user wrote in its request by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8415
* Open the workflow when its notification is clicked by @Sniezka1927 in https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/pull/8430
* Tell the agent that a WhatsApp list has only the allowed chats by @Sniezka1927 in https://github
